sections.title: Hero Updates
sections.description: General Shotgun patterns no longer apply random rotation. This will affect the following heroes: Ashe Doomfist D.Va Reaper Roadhog Torbjörn

heroes.dev_note: When combined with the changes to shotgun patterns, we’re looking to keep Roadhog’s Chain Hook combo reliable, but not overly powerful against heroes with higher health pools.

changes.text_en: Projectile damage reduced from 7 to 6 (150 total per shot)

heroes.dev_note: This change to Torbjörn’s secondary fire is aimed at giving it a stronger role at close range. We’re hoping this change allows each shot to feel more impactful, since it has a larger burst. To keep this change in line, we’ve also reduced the damage-per-second.

changes.text_en: Damage increased from 10.5 to 12.5 per projectile (125 total per shot)
